question: Which of the following is a part of the human male reproductive system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prostate gland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **prostate gland** is a part of the **male reproductive system** in humans. It is located just below the bladder and surrounds the urethra.
 
• This gland plays a crucial role in the production of **seminal fluid**, which nourishes and transports sperm during ejaculation.
 
• The prostate gland produces a fluid that constitutes approximately **30% of the semen volume**. This fluid contains enzymes, zinc, and citric acid, which contribute to sperm viability and motility.
